units.source_text: 我不曾忘记当年失意之时你所说的一句话呢。”

en.t: I have never forgotten the words you spoke to me back then, when I was in despair."

units.source_text: 他一边吟诗，一边送花，姿态异常优美，脸上笑容可掬。

en.t: As he recited the poem, he offered the flowers; his bearing was extraordinarily graceful, and his face wore a charming smile.

units.source_text: 乳母难于为情，无地自容，只得腼颜答道：

en.t: The nurse felt terribly embarrassed and hardly knew where to put herself, so she could only answer with a bashful face:
